title: Choosing a service language
summary: You can write a Tac service in JavaScript, TypeScript, Rust, Go, C#, F#, Swift, Kotlin, Java, Dart or Ruby. Lua and Python work with limits. "Which languages can I use?" lists every language, what it can do, and the languages that Tachyon does not support. A service runs in the page on every target, also inside a native app. Some native hosts link Rust, Swift, Kotlin or C# services instead.
